overlapRule: Overlap adjacent pieces by 8-18 percent; never leave a regular grid seam.
removalRule: A cover entry is removed whole; underlying scene art is never replaced by a socket.

variationRules.round_leaf: Use 2-4 times, scale 0.70-1.25, rotate -20 to +20 degrees.
variationRules.monstera_leaf: Use 2-4 times, scale 0.65-1.15, rotate -30 to +30 degrees.
variationRules.fern_fan: Use 1-3 times as tall diagonals, scale 0.65-1.10, rotate -35 to +35 degrees.
variationRules.flower_clump: Use 1-3 times as colorful small interrupters, scale 0.55-0.90, rotate -20 to +20 degrees.
variationRules.scalloped_vine: Use 1-3 times as seam bridges, scale 0.60-1.00, rotate -25 to +25 degrees.
variationRules.corner_canopy: Use once or twice at corners, scale 0.75-1.20, rotate only when its corner silhouette remains useful.
